title: Research: Linux host configuration management and hardening by a pull agent
goal: The kb answers, from official sources, how a pull agent converges and grades Linux hosts of four families (Debian, Ubuntu, Alpine, AlmaLinux): CIS Benchmark Level 1 and Level 2 server profiles and their per-family content, OpenSCAP with the SCAP Security Guide profiles and Lynis where none exists, nftables rulesets, auditd rules, sshd hardening, time sync, unattended-upgrade timers off and package pins by snapshot date, point release or index hash, Docker as a role with secrets as /run mounts never env, WireGuard hub-and-spoke meshes rendered from an inventory, cloudflared tunnel replicas and Cloudflare Access for an admin path, Incus machine containers as a test bed for cookbooks, a static agent binary that fetches a git main and refuses a backwards version, idempotent typed steps with check and apply and dry-run, and dead-man monitors on a second provider.

gates.question: Approve this sprint's goal and committed items?
